schema.GENERIC: Use the approved tool input shape and constraints.
schema.TYPE: Provide the type required by the tool schema at this location.
schema.CHOICE: Choose a value declared in the tool schema at this location.
schema.MINIMUM: Provide the required nonempty value or minimum-sized collection.
schema.MAXIMUM: Reduce this value or collection to the tool schema limit.
schema.FORMAT: Use the format declared in the tool schema at this location.
schema.KEYS: Remove undeclared fields; use only the tool schema keys.
schema.SHAPE: Use one of the complete object or value shapes declared in the tool schema.
schema.CONSTRAINT: Follow the tool schema constraint at this location.

query_contract.GENERIC: Use the approved query contract; no SQL or undeclared controls are accepted.
query_contract.COLUMN: Choose a selectable column from the configured table contract.
query_contract.TIME_FORMAT: Use a real UTC ISO-8601 timestamp ending in Z, with at most millisecond precision.
query_contract.INTEGER: Use an in-range integer; large bigint values may use the approved decimal-string form.
query_contract.FILTER_STRING: Use a bounded string without control characters for this filter value.
query_contract.FILTER_LIMIT: Reduce the filters collection to the approved query limit.
query_contract.NULL_VALUE: Omit value entirely for is_null and is_not_null.
query_contract.IN_VALUES: Provide a nonempty IN collection within the approved query limit.
query_contract.OPERATOR_TYPE: Use ordered comparisons only on numeric or timestamp columns.
query_contract.OPERATOR: Use an approved operator for this column type; text matching requires a string column.
query_contract.TIME_WINDOW: Use a positive start-inclusive, end-exclusive range within utc_query_window_days.
query_contract.CATALOG_DATES: Keep both time bounds within the catalog date projection range.
query_contract.RESULT_LIMIT: Use an integer result limit within the approved query maximum.
query_contract.PROJECTION: Provide a nonempty projection within the approved query field limit.
query_contract.SORT_DIRECTION: Use asc or desc for the sort direction.
query_contract.GROUP_BY: Choose distinct fields from this table's aggregate_group_by reference, within the grouping limit.
query_contract.METRICS: Provide a nonempty metrics collection within the approved query limit.
query_contract.METRIC_FUNCTION: Use an approved aggregate function; count takes no field.
query_contract.METRIC_TYPE: Choose an int or bigint column for this aggregate metric.
query_contract.DUPLICATE_METRICS: Choose groups and metrics with distinct output names.

tool_contract.GENERIC: Use the approved tool contract and its bounded fields; this request was not executed.
